text: The billing counter just added it to your bill.
Shops can sell bags, but buying one must be your choice.
Printed with the shop's name or logo? Then they can't charge for it.
They can't stop you bringing your own empty bag.
And notices at the entrance must tell you before you shop.
Logo bag? Ask for it free. Plain bag? Say no, or bring your own.
